comment.body:
Closing without merging following review.

**Rejection category:** `technical`
**Reviewed head:** `40591e485bbea94d4f035e395dfb2c61fa753712`

**Reason:** The full horizontal Capital One composition is unsuitable at the small display sizes: the PR itself states that "at 24-32 px the wordmark is illegible and at 48 px marginal". The October 6 audit confirmed the 24/32 px problem. A failed usability check cannot be treated as a neutral caveat while the candidate is marked suitable.

**Required follow-up for the maintenance agent:** Find a supported compact original vector and verify the complete mark at 24 and 32 px on both backgrounds. If no suitable original variant is available, do not make this replacement. The rejection concerns this composition, not a blanket ban on wordmarks.

This decision is based on `bank-icons-audit-2026-10-06.md`, `bank-icons-review-2026-10-05.pdf`, and `bank-icons-crosscheck-2026-10-05.pdf`, with the audit corrections taking precedence over unsupported cross-review claims.

[Supporting evidence](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/58a0f09e122e84fd27e7673947c8668f7708127c/review-materials/15596/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

This rejection applies to this candidate, not permanently to the bank. A fresh proposal must resolve the specific defect above.
